name: pkg2.k
smt:
; ================
; === Options: ===
; ================

(set-option :smt.macro-finder true)

; ======================
; === String Theory: ===
; ======================

; Z3 4.13.0+ requires explicit logic or theory declaration for strings
(set-logic ALL)

; ===========================
; === Built-in datatypes: ===
; ===========================

(define-sort Ref () Int)

(declare-datatypes (T1 T2) ((Tuple2 (mk-Tuple2 (_1 T1)(_2 T2)))))
(declare-datatypes (T1 T2 T3) ((Tuple3 (mk-Tuple3 (_1 T1)(_2 T2)(_3 T3)))))


; ===============================
; === User-defined datatypes: ===
; ===============================

(declare-datatypes () ((Container (mk-Container (helper Ref)(name String)))))
(declare-datatypes () ((Helper (mk-Helper (value Int)))))
(declare-datatypes () ((Unused (mk-Unused (unused_field Real)))))

; =============
; === Heap: ===
; =============

(declare-datatypes () ((Any
  (lift-Container (sel-Container Container))
  (lift-Helper (sel-Helper Helper))
  (lift-Unused (sel-Unused Unused))
  null))
)

(declare-const heap (Array Ref Any))
(declare-const NULL$ String)
(declare-const NULL$Ref Ref)
(assert (= NULL$Ref (- 1)))

(define-fun deref ((ref Ref)) Any
  (select heap ref)
)

; ==========================================
; === Class specific is/deref-functions: ===
; ==========================================

(define-fun deref-is-Container ((this Ref)) Bool
  (is-lift-Container (deref this))
)

(define-fun deref-Container ((this Ref)) Container
  (sel-Container (deref this))
)

(define-fun deref-is-Helper ((this Ref)) Bool
  (is-lift-Helper (deref this))
)

(define-fun deref-Helper ((this Ref)) Helper
  (sel-Helper (deref this))
)

(define-fun deref-is-Unused ((this Ref)) Bool
  (is-lift-Unused (deref this))
)

(define-fun deref-Unused ((this Ref)) Unused
  (sel-Unused (deref this))
)

; ======================
; === Isa-functions: ===
; ======================

(define-fun deref-isa-Container ((this Ref)) Bool
  (deref-is-Container this)
)

(define-fun deref-isa-Helper ((this Ref)) Bool
  (deref-is-Helper this)
)

(define-fun deref-isa-Unused ((this Ref)) Bool
  (deref-is-Unused this)
)

; ================
; === Getters: ===
; ================

; --------------------------------
;   Getters for class Container:
; --------------------------------

; --- getters for Container.helper: ---

(define-fun Container!helper ((this Ref)) Ref
  (helper (deref-Container this))
)

; ================
; === Methods: ===
; ================

; ===================
; === Invariants: ===
; ===================

; ----------------------------------
;   Invariant for class Container:
; ----------------------------------

; --- Constants: ---

(declare-const const-1-Container Container)

; --- Invariant 1: ---

(define-fun Container.inv1 ((this Ref)) Bool
  (deref-isa-Helper (Container!helper this))
)

(assert (! (Container.inv1 1) :named _xkassert0))



; -------------------------------
;   Invariant for class Helper:
; -------------------------------

; --- Constants: ---

(declare-const const-2-Helper Helper)



; -------------------------------
;   Invariant for class Unused:
; -------------------------------

; --- Constants: ---

(declare-const const-3-Unused Unused)




; ======================
; === Generate heap: ===
; ======================

(assert
  (=
    heap
    (store(store(store
      ((as const (Array Ref Any)) null)
        1 (lift-Container const-1-Container))
        2 (lift-Helper const-2-Helper))
        3 (lift-Unused const-3-Unused))
  )
)
smtModel:
(define-fun const-1-Container () Container
  (mk-Container 2 "!0!"))
(define-fun const-2-Helper () Helper
  (mk-Helper 4))
(define-fun _xkassert0 () Bool
  (let ((a!1 (select heap (helper (sel-Container (select heap 1))))))
  (is-lift-Helper a!1)))
(define-fun NULL$Ref () Int
  (- 1))
(define-fun const-3-Unused () Unused
  (mk-Unused 0.0))
(define-fun heap () (Array Int Any)
  (let ((a!1 (store (store ((as const (Array Int Any)) null)
                         1
                         (lift-Container (mk-Container 2 "!0!")))
                  2
                  (lift-Helper (mk-Helper 4)))))
  (store a!1 3 (lift-Unused (mk-Unused 0.0)))))
